overview: Built an automated document processing system for managing client agreements, invoices, folders, and sales pitch files.
The workflow takes pending client records and automatically creates the required documents, organizes files, updates processing status, and keeps Google Sheets and SmartSuite synchronized.

list: Receives a processing request through a webhook
Retrieves pending agreement records from Google Sheets
Generates agreements automatically from document templates
Retrieves pending invoice records from Google Sheets
Generates invoices automatically from predefined templates
Creates a standardized customer name for file management
Searches Google Drive for the customer folder
Creates a new customer folder when required
Generates the customer sales pitch from a template
Updates SmartSuite with success or failure status
Marks processed records in Google Sheets
Handles existing folders and Google Drive processing errors

blocks.p: The workflow uses predefined document and sales pitch templates for automated file creation.

list: Customer information
Agreement content
Invoice information
Sales pitch content
Document structure

blocks.p: This keeps generated client documents consistent while reducing manual document preparation.
Google Sheets acts as the central processing queue and tracking system.
Each completed record is updated with:

list: Processing status
Agreement status
Invoice status
Customer folder status

result: A complete automated document processing pipeline that turns pending client records into organized agreements, invoices, customer folders, and sales pitch files without requiring manual document creation for every client. The system also keeps processing status, client records, and generated files organized in one workflow.
